o1: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity. Enables Rho GTPase activator activity. Predicted to be involved in signal transduction. Is involved in embryonic body morphogenesis. Is part of the embryonic elongation pathway; Rho protein signal transduction pathway. Is located in the actin cytoskeleton. Is expressed in the epidermis; rectum; socket cell; uterus; and vulva. Interacts with RHO-1. Orthologous to several human genes including ARHGAP20 (Rho GTPase activating protein 20).
